title: One Writer at a Time — A Council of Five Keeping One Law
description: Viewstamped Replication told in the Tholos of Schedia: five legislators, one law, a single writer who alone may write the law, copiers who keep duplicate copies, and a new writer chosen from the fullest copy a majority can show.
question: Many systems put one leader in charge at a time. When the leader falls silent, how does another take over without losing anything the last one promised?
how: We find out by exploring how Schedia, a Greek city on Paxos with laws of its own, kept its law with one legislator at a time serving as the writer, and how a new writer took over when the last one fell silent.

papers.authors: Brian M. Oki and Barbara H. Liskov
papers.title: Viewstamped Replication: A New Primary Copy Method to Support Highly-Available Distributed Systems
